note: Original AOP voice identity. Candidates are described, never cloned from a real person. Each candidate's reference clip is generated once with Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (fixed seed) and then locked: runtime speech uses the Base model conditioned on that clip, so the identity is stable across responses. Re-running design with a different seed creates a different voice — bump the id when you do.

candidates.name: AOP CORE A — calm / low / formal
candidates.instruct: A composed, sophisticated adult male AI assistant in his forties. Low-mid pitch, calm authority, precise articulation and a measured, slightly deliberate pace. Clean, dry studio recording with no room reverb. Subtle warmth, never theatrical, never exaggerated, minimal breathiness. Not an announcer and not a game character. Natural conversational prosody with clear sentence-final intonation in Korean and English.
